sloka: यश्यास्तव पतिस्त्यक्तोराजा दशरथः स्वयम् ।भर्ता सर्वस्य जगतः स्थावरस्य चरश्य च ॥२-३५-५॥
transliteration: yaśyāstava patistyaktorājā daśarathaḥ svayam ।bhartā sarvasya jagataḥ sthāvarasya caraśya ca ॥2-35-5॥

translations.english: O Kaikeyi you have forsaken king Dasaratha, your husband and the lord of this entire world consisting of the movable and the immovable immovable and movable world. There is nothing in this world which you are notcapable of doing.
